summary: Iran conducted over 115 strikes on 26 U.S. military sites through August, targeting electronic warfare radars, aircraft, and facilities, with Kuwait particularly affected. UKMTO recorded more than 30 attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz, Gulf of Oman, and Arabian Gulf in October, the highest monthly total of the Iran war. Iranian officials acknowledge discussing nuclear doctrine changes if another war occurs, while Qatari mediation has shortened Tehran's proposed timeline for reopening the Strait of Hormuz from seven to two days. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9265, @Faytuks_Network/9242, @yediotnews25/137070, @Faytuks_Network/9272)
